title: Coefficient of a binary polynomial product
statement: Let $a,b\colon\{0,1\}^{\ell}\to\mathbb{F}_2$ be binary vectors, and let $d\in\mathbb{N}$. The coefficient of degree $d$ in the product of the polynomials whose coefficients are the entries of $a$ and $b$ is the sum of $a_i b_j$ over all pairs of indices with $i+j=d$, taking a term to be zero if either index is outside $\{0,\ldots,\ell-1\}$.
